messages:
maria: FYI canary deploy of sparkhaven-7b-q4a showing weird token repeat + 'SYSTEM:' prefix in outputs. Saw on 10% traffic after 09:15 UTC. Logs attached below.

devon: Interesting. Is this only on q4a? any difference on full-precision?

maria: only on 4-bit qparams so far. fp16 and 8-bit look fine in canary. Quick log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18 09:16:02] step=12 token='SYSTEM:' logprob=-0.01
generated: "SYSTEM: SYSTEM: user: hello"
```

lukas: looks tokenizer-adjacent? Could be EOS bias or bad special tokens mapping after quant. Any tokenizer-vocab diffs in model.json?

maria: model.json same as training; but eval-harness shows tokenization mismatch for sequences with leading 'SYSTEM:'.

sara: Can you paste the quantization config you used?

maria: `--quantize=4bit --scheme=q4_0 --group-size=128 --fuse-attn=true`

alan: @eng-runtime can KV cache interact badly with fused kernels? I remember a bug where kv indexing + 4-bit produced incorrect tile alignment.

devon: good call. Are we seeing this only with KV enabled?

maria: yes, turning off KV cache or forcing serial decoding removes repeat but increases latency. With KV on, p99 latency drops but outputs repeat.

eval-bot: Quick eval summary: on eval-set-llm-v2: repetition_rate +8% vs baseline, bleu unaffected, perplexity +2.3. Regression only on prompts containing control tokens.

lukas: maybe special tokens token ids end up remapped post-quant because of padding alignment. Can you run `python inspect_vocab.py --model sparkhaven-7b --compare`

maria: running now. Also attaching short repro script:
```
from redwood_client import Client
client = Client(model='sparkhaven-7b-q4a')
print(client.generate('SYSTEM: please summarize'))
```

devon: If repro is small we can run in runtime canary with debug logging on. @oncall-sre can you allocate a canary node with kv disabled and another with kv enabled?

oncall-sre: allocated two nodes: canary-qa-1 (kv=off), canary-qa-2 (kv=on). I also bumped logs to debug.

sara: I'll run tokenizer compare and quant stats. If it's deterministic it's likely kernel bug; we should try different group-size too.

alan: If kernel bug, fallback to non-fused attn for 4-bit as temporary mitigation.

maria: plan: 1) isolate tokenization diff (sara), 2) repro/debug on canaries (devon + oncall), 3) try group-size/disable-fused as mitigation (alan), 4) pause rollout if regression >5% on canary (maria).

devon: I'll post a short PR for a canary rollback policy flag if we need immediate rollbacks.

maria: thanks. I'll update product+success (cc @sara) and open a postmortem thread if we have to roll back. tagging: @eng-ml, @eng-runtime, @eng-sre

deploy-bot: Deployment sparkhaven-7b-q4a canary -> 10% at 09:13 UTC

maria: updated last check 09:42 UTC — reproducer confirmed, mitigation applied (disable kv on q4a canaries). Rolling out mitigation across canaries now. Thx everyone :heart:
